# routeur_project (Data Source)

Looks up a project in a workspace by `slug` or `id` — for example a workspace's default project. A project in a workspace. API keys belong to one project, and routing rules, policies and budgets can be scoped to one.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "routeur_workspace" "default" {
  slug = "default"
}

# Look a project up by slug…
data "routeur_project" "core" {
  workspace_id = data.routeur_workspace.default.id
  slug         = "core"
}

# …or by id, e.g. the workspace's default project.
data "routeur_project" "default" {
  workspace_id = data.routeur_workspace.default.id
  id           = data.routeur_workspace.default.default_project_id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `workspace_id` (String) Id of the workspace to look in (`ws_…`).

### Optional

- `id` (String) Public id of the project (`proj_…`). Set exactly one of `id` and `slug`.
- `slug` (String) The project's slug. Set exactly one of `id` and `slug`.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) When it was created (RFC 3339, UTC).
- `description` (String) Free-text description, at most 255 characters. Stored verbatim; `""` stays `""`.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the project is enabled.
- `is_default` (Boolean) Whether this is the workspace's default project, which cannot be disabled or deleted.
- `name` (String) Display name, 1–80 characters, without leading or trailing whitespace.
- `updated_at` (String) When it was last changed (RFC 3339, UTC).
